default_status.description: Status of versions the versions list does not mention: affected, unaffected or unknown.

changes.description: Versions inside the range where status stops applying, such as a backported fix.

$schema.description: A URL to the JSON Schema for this object.

affected_cpe_matches.description: NVD's affected CPEs with their version ranges, one entry per range: NVD repeats a CPE with a different range per release branch. Empty until CVErt Ops ingests an NVD record with configurations for the CVE. A CPE that carries its version in the string has no range fields.

affected_cpes.description: Every CPE the sources name for this CVE, once each. Includes platforms NVD marks not vulnerable, such as the operating system an affected application runs on. For what is affected, read affected_cpe_matches.

cna_affected.description: Products and versions as the CVE Numbering Authority published them, which can be present before NVD analyses the CVE. Holds the distinct entries of both the CVE record and NVD's copy of it, so a product can appear twice when one copy lags the other. Empty until CVErt Ops ingests a record carrying this data, so an empty list does not mean the CNA published none.

advisory_id.description: Advisory or CVE ID; works with GET /cves/{cve_id}.

cvss_v3_score.description: The advisory's CVSS v3 base score.

epss_score.description: Highest EPSS score of the CVEs in cve_ids; null when none of them has a score, which means not known.

fix_ecosystem.description: The ecosystem of the package range that names fixed_version, preferring the item's own when several do. For an Ubuntu item it can be the release's other stream: Ubuntu:Pro:<release> means the fix is published only through Ubuntu Pro. Null when fixed_version is null or comes from an NVD or CNA range.

fix_major.description: Whether fixed_version is in the same major release as the version; null when fixed_version is null.

fixed_version.description: The lowest version the advisory data no longer reports as affected; null when none is known.

in_cisa_kev.description: Whether any CVE in cve_ids is in CISA KEV; null when the record names no CVE that is held, which means not known, not false.

matched_ranges.description: Ranges that contain the version. At most 20.

matched_ranges_total.description: How many ranges contain the version. Verdicts and fixes use all of them.

reason.description: Why the advisory could not be evaluated; null when it is affected.

severity.description: The advisory's severity, as the feed sent it.

verdict.description: This advisory's verdict for the version.

kind.description: package for the purl and ecosystem forms, product for the CPE form.

name.description: Package name as given, for a package.

part.description: CPE part, lower-cased, for a product.

product.description: CPE product, lower-cased, for a product.

vendor.description: CPE vendor, lower-cased, for a product.

affected.description: Advisory records that report the version affected.

cannot_evaluate.description: Advisory records that could not be evaluated for the version.

cannot_evaluate_by_reason.description: The advisory records that could not be evaluated, by reason, counted before the listing limit: each record is counted once, under the reason it shows. The values sum to cannot_evaluate.

not_affected.description: Advisory records that do not report the version affected.

retracted.description: Advisory records whose CVE is rejected or withdrawn; they take no part in the status.

complete.description: The feed has finished a full walk and succeeded within 7 days.

last_success_at.description: When the feed last succeeded; null if never.

name.description: Feed name, as feed_sync_state names it.

cpe.description: CPE 2.3 formatted string with literal part, vendor and product. At most 512 characters.

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem name; a distribution ecosystem must name a release, such as Debian:13.

id.description: Caller's identifier for the item, echoed back. At most 128 characters.

name.description: Package name in the ecosystem. At most 512 characters.

purl.description: Package URL with a version. At most 1024 characters. Types npm, pypi, golang, maven, cargo, gem, nuget, pub, hex, composer, deb (with a distro qualifier) and apk (with a distro qualifier).

version.description: Version to check. At most 256 characters. With a CPE it may be omitted when the CPE's own version component holds it.

message.description: A fixed sentence explaining the code. It never repeats the item's values.

advisories.description: Advisories that report the version affected or cannot be evaluated: affected first, then those in CISA KEV, then by score. At most 100.

advisories_truncated.description: More advisories applied than are listed. Status and counts use all of them.

component.description: What the item was checked as; null for an invalid item.

counts.description: Counts of advisory records found for the item, by verdict.

data_complete.description: Every feed this item depends on is complete.

error.description: Why the item could not be read; null unless status is invalid.

id.description: The item's id, or null when it had none or it was too long.

index.description: Position of the item in the request.

reason.description: Set when an item-level rule gave the status; null when the status comes from the listed advisories, each of which carries its own reason. invalid_version: the item's own version order cannot read its version. sdk_version_not_comparable: a microsoft:.net or .net_core version numbered as an SDK (third component 100 or more, as 10.0.404); NVD and Microsoft state runtime versions, so send the runtime version (SDKs before 2.1.300 cannot be told apart). A .NET item checks the .NET runtime; ASP.NET Core is checked under its own CPE, microsoft:asp.net_core. too_many_ranges: an advisory has more ranges than the per-advisory limit. evaluation_failed: a comparison failed for an unclassified reason. data_incomplete: a feed the item depends on has not finished a full walk or has not succeeded for 7 days; it applies with no advisory too. distro_stream_incomplete: an Ubuntu stream other than a release's standard or plain Pro stream (FIPS or Realtime under Pro, NVIDIA BlueField) lists only some of its release's advisories, so its items are never cleared.

status.description: Only not_affected clears a version. affected: at least one advisory reports this version affected. not_affected: every advisory found was decided and none reports the version affected; the version is not in any analysed or CNA-named advisory held. unresolved: no advisory was established as affected, and the data leaves one or more advisories unresolved for this version; not a clean result: see each listed advisory's reason and counts.cannot_evaluate_by_reason. cannot_evaluate: the check could not be completed for this item; see reason, or, when reason is null, the listed advisories. no_advisory_found: no matching advisory was found in the searched data, which is not a statement that the component is safe. invalid: the item could not be read; see error.

cpe.description: The CPE of an NVD CPE match.

ecosystem.description: The stored ecosystem of a package range. An Ubuntu item reads both its release's standard and Ubuntu Pro streams, so this names the stream the range came from.

evidence.description: Where the range comes from: a package range, an NVD CPE match, or the CNA's affected data.

introduced.description: Lower bound, inclusive; empty when the range has none.

post.description: For each listed component version, says which advisories affect it, which range matched, and the lowest version the advisory data no longer reports as affected. Takes 1 to 500 items within the 1 MiB request limit, and reads only the global CVE corpus. An item that cannot be read is answered with status invalid, and the others are still answered. no_advisory_found means nothing is known about the component, not that it is safe; not_affected means the version is not in any analysed or CNA-named advisory held. Answers 422 with problem type urn:cvert:error:candidate_limit_exceeded when the request reads more candidate rows than one request may (split the request), and 503 when no check slot is free (with Retry-After) or the check did not finish within 30 seconds. Item values are not stored or logged.
